paragraphs: Rabbi Acha (perhaps Abba should be read; see there), son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, said in Rabbi Chiyya’s name (perhaps bar Abba should be read), in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, Berakhot, chapter 2, 14a. Nedarim 10b: Rav Acha, son of Rabbi Chiyya, spoke to Rav Ashi; I do not know whether this is he. In Rabbi Yonatan’s name.
